entities.name: Edgar Vincent, 1st Viscount D'Abernon

entities.summary: Edgar Vincent, 1st Viscount D'Abernon, was a British politician, diplomat, art collector and author. He played an important role in the negotiations behind the 1925 Locarno Pact between Germany and its neighbours.
